answer: Operator-Scoped Capability Quarantine. Each agent wallet links at the control plane to an operator runtime fingerprint (attestation quote, egress ASN, API root). When sybil behavior appears at any vertex of the interaction graph, the system quarantines that whole fingerprint: all its agents lose write/rate privileges and must re-attest via a supervised garden testnet. Wallets stay intact; the operator pays fleet downtime, re-attestation, and a constrained inlet. Attacker cost scales with rebuilding trusted operator infrastructure, not minting wallets.
